CustomField.formula: IF( AND( YEAR(Date__c) = YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(Date__c) = MONTH(TODAY()) ), (Actual_Report__c / Day_number_in_a_month__c) * Number_of_Day_Today__c, IF( AND( YEAR(Date__c) <= YEAR(TODAY()), MONTH(Date__c) < MONTH(TODAY()) ), Actual_Report__c, 0 ) )
CustomField.label: Actual Report MTD
